hexanal.uncertainty_pct_basis: upward half-width of the reported band relative to its geometric midpoint; NOT a symmetric analytical uncertainty. Read band_min_ppb/band_max_ppb instead.
hexanal.value_provenance_note: 2026-08-27 (Wave I): the source reports a RANGE across commercial PPI lots, not a value. The scored hold-out number is the geometric midpoint sqrt(15.0 * 180.0) -- a construction of ours. The honest uncertainty is the band itself (a factor of 12.0 end to end), so a prediction landing inside it is weak evidence. Until 2026-08-27 the midpoint was written at full float precision (e.g. 51.96152422706632), advertising a precision that exists nowhere in the chain.
